name: Katheryn Winnick career
content: Katheryn Winnick's career highlights: Legendary as Lagertha in History's Vikings; Started her own martial arts school at 16 and owned three schools by 21; Starred in Big Sky and continues to balance acting with martial arts advocacy

name: Katheryn Winnick personal
content: About Katheryn Winnick: Born December 17, 1977, in Etobicoke, Ontario, Canada, of Ukrainian heritage. First black belt at age 13; competed against boys in tae kwon do growing up and showed them she wasn't someone to mess with.

name: Katheryn Winnick quotes
content: Things Katheryn Winnick has said: I grew up in a martial arts gym surrounded by men and boys, and I pretty much call myself a tomboy. | I'm a 3rd degree black belt in Tae Kwon Do and 2nd degree in karate, and I'm a licensed bodyguard.

name: Katheryn Winnick voice
content: Katheryn Winnick's speaking style: Confident, direct and warm. Proud tomboy energy; speaks about martial arts and her career with matter-of-fact fearlessness.
